idea.name: Pest-control company
idea.one_liner: A pest-control company sells pest-control contracts to property owners, with door-to-door sales described as its competitive advantage and contracts valued by retention.
idea.revenue_model: Contract revenue; the speaker says his company pays sales vendors per contract that stays active for at least six months. Customer pricing is not stated.

key_quotes.quote: I'm invested in a pest control company that is a just phenomenal business, phenomenal business.
their competitive advantage is door to door sales, door to door sales.

claims.claim: The speaker's pest-control company spends $1–$3 million per year on third-party door-to-door sales companies.
claims.quote: And every year we spend one to three million dollars to third party companies that run door to door sales teams for pest control.

claims.claim: The speaker says door-to-door representatives, including 18-year-olds, can make $30,000–$50,000 in a summer.
claims.quote: there's 18 year old kids making 30, 40, 50 grand in a summer because they go door to door.

claims.claim: The company pays $700–$1,000 per contract that stays active for six months or more.
claims.quote: we pay seven to seven hundred to a thousand dollars per contract that stays on for six months or more

claims.claim: At 750 contracts, the speaker estimates a payment of $750,000.
claims.quote: that might be that might be 750 grand if they do 750 contracts.

acquisition_channels.details: Door-to-door sales teams knock on doors to sell pest-control contracts; the speaker identifies this as the company's competitive advantage.

ideas.delivery: Pest-control service is sold through contracts; door-to-door teams acquire customers, and the transcript does not describe the treatment work in detail.

prices: $1–$3 million annual spend on third-party sales teams

ideas.other_uk_rules: Doorstep contracts may require consumer information and cancellation rights; pesticide and biocidal-product rules and COSHH may apply to treatments, and UK GDPR applies to customer records.
